pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Prioritize action based on FIRE score
  • Read notes from any previous interactions to determine next best step
  • A new lead is protected for 5 days. Be sure to advance the lead to “working” within this timeframe

• Review FIRE score for increased or recent engagement
  • Execute a low-touch cadence to keep the prospect interested until they are ready to meet
  • Move the lead status to “converted” if a DC is set
  • Move the lead status to “unqualified” if you no future interacted is appropriate

• Execute a strategic contact plan (i.e., high-touch or low-touch cadence) to schedule a Discovery Call
  • Log every attempt to contact
  • The lead is protected for 6 months based on last attempt to contact date.
  • Move the lead status to “converted” if a DC is set
  • Move the lead status to “nurturing” if you’ve made contact and want to stay passively engaged
  • Move the lead status to “unqualified” if you no future interacted is appropriate
